reference_method: Selected Vietnamese labels and financial figures were manually transcribed from rendered scan pages and visually checked against the visible report. The signed income-statement figures on PDF page 10 were cross-checked against the official annual report; added balance-sheet anchors are direct visual transcriptions from PDF pages 7 and 8.
limitations: Three pages from one third-party preview packet; only the income-statement page has figure corroboration against the issuer-hosted annual report. Added balance-sheet figures are visual transcriptions from the scan itself. Diagnostic only: not representative of Vietnamese scans, not eligible for primary model selection, and not evidence of safe automatic financial publication. Coordinate annotations cover 10 selected balance-sheet rows (20 numeric cells), derived from the source PDF text layer and visually checked against the scan; they are not independently click-annotated and do not cover the income-statement page. No paired OCR-engine comparison is included.

environment.cpu_peak_scope: whole evaluator process; run one engine per invocation for engine-specific comparison
environment.child_peak_scope: maximum high-water RSS among completed child processes, where supported
